services.desc: Hi, I’m Buck, and I’m an Appaloosa! I love my girlfriend Lucy, my special friend Susan and all my riders. I came to PRANCE in 2014 and have worked hard to fit in. It’s true, I prefer the mares and don’t like to share a paddock with the other boys but that’s okay, I am a bit of a ladies man! Can you believe, someone even made a miniature version of me so that they could cuddle with me at home? Thanks for making me feel so special despite my funny haircut. I love being here! Hi! My name is Dolly and I am a 17 year-old Haflinger. I am a truly gentle soul who helps people heal and takes good care of my riders. My mom is Rebecca, the PRANCE therapist. blurb: PRANCE offers therapeutic riding lessons and integrated camps for children and adults with disabilities. Programs include horseback riding lessons, horsemanship, and equine-assisted therapy. The center focuses on physical, emotional, and social benefits through interaction with horses.
extraNote: Riders accepted on a trial basis · Priority given to children with special needs for camps · Financial help available for summer camp to qualifying applicants · Miramichi Farms, Eastern shore of Lake Huron near Port Elgin, Ontario · July and August for summer camps; spring and fall for riding sessions
